decisions.reason: Assigning INA3221 channels to measure the 3.3V and 5V rails does not change the standalone 3.3V supply, its regulator, activation condition, loads, or source-selection behavior.
Measuring the 5V rail does not change its GPIO switching, powered loads, voltage, or shutdown behavior.
The monitoring-channel assignment does not alter the AXP2101 battery or USB power path.
Monitoring both voltage rails does not necessarily change the interboard connector pinouts, board power topology, or power distribution.
The source decision does not change the LEDs' 5V supply or their level-shifter requirement.
Rail-current monitoring is unrelated to the battery connector's series, pin count, pin functions, mounting type, or unresolved pinout.
The monitoring-channel assignment does not affect the ESP32 BOOT or reset circuitry.
Measuring the 3.3V and 5V rails does not change the selected ESP32 module or its breakout requirement.
The source decision does not alter native USB enumeration or USB-C programming behavior.
Current measurement of the 5V rail does not change the LED power-cutoff behavior, control GPIO, or standby-current target.
The electrical monitoring-channel assignment does not entail any change to the power board's mechanical layout.
The source decision does not change I2C pull-ups, series resistors, bus speed, cable length, or signal conditioning.
